paragraphs.en: Much of the work in today's world is accomplished ( (完成) ) in teams.Most people believe the best way to build a great team is to {gather} a group of the most {talented} individuals.Sports team {owners} spend millions of {dollars} to {trade} for {top} talent in the hope of {qualifying} for championships.However, the salary {cap} often becomes a significant constraint, forcing teams to make difficult decisions.Companies spend millions {hiring} top business people.Is their money well spent?
paragraphs.cn: 当今世界的许多工作都是以团队形式完成的。大多数人认为，组建一个优秀团队的最佳方式是 <u> 聚集 </u> 一群最 <u> 有才华的 </u> 人。体育队的 <u> 老板 </u> 们花费数百万 <u> 美元 </u> 来 <u> 交易顶尖 </u> 人才，期望能够 <u> 获得 </u> 参加锦标赛的 <u> 资格 </u> 。然而，薪资 <u> 上限 </u> 常常会成为重要的制约因素，迫使团队做出艰难的决策。公司花费数百万美元 <u> 聘请 </u> 顶级商务人士。他们的钱花得值吗？

paragraphs.en: Several recent studies examined the role of talent in the sports world.They focused on {football} , {basketball} and {baseball} .The results are {mixed} .For football and basketball, adding talented players to a team proves a good method, but only up to the point where 70% of the players are top talent; {above} that level, the team's performance begins to {decline} . {Interestingly} , this {trend} isn't {evident} in baseball, where additional individual talent keeps improving the team's performance.
paragraphs.cn: 最近有几项研究探讨了天赋在体育界的作用。这些研究聚焦于 <u> 足球 </u> 、 <u> 篮球 </u> 和 <u> 棒球 </u> 。研究结果很 <u> 复杂 </u> 。对于足球和篮球而言，为球队增加天才球员被证明是一个好方法，但前提是顶尖球员的比例不超过70%； <u> 超过 </u> 这个比例，球队的表现就会开始 <u> 下滑 </u> 。 <u> 有趣的是 </u> ，这种 <u> 趋势 </u> 在棒球运动中并不 <u> 明显 </u> 。在棒球队中，增加天才球员会持续提升球队的表现。

paragraphs.en: To explain this phenomenon, the researchers explored the degree to which a good performance by a team requires its members to coordinate ( (协调) ) their actions.This task {interdependence} {distinguishes} baseball from football and basketball.In baseball, the performance of individual players is less dependent on {teammates} .They conclude that a sports team is like a ship navigating through tough games, when the {chemistry} between players becomes critical, the ship's voyage will be troubled if there is too much talent {aboard} .If a basketball {star} , for example, thinks that he {deserves} a high personal point total during a {season} , he may take a {shot} himself when it would be better to pass the ball to a teammate.Young children learning to play team sports are often told,”There is no I in TEAM.”Stars {apparently} do not follow this {basic} principle of {sportsmanship} .
paragraphs.cn: 为了解释这一现象，研究人员探究了一支球队的良好表现对成员之间协调行动的要求程度。这种任务上的 <u> 相互依赖 </u> 使棒球 <u> 有别 </u> 于足球和篮球。在棒球比赛中，单个球员的表现较少受到 <u> 队友 </u> 的影响。研究人员得出结论：一支运动队就如同在艰难比赛中航行的船只，当球员之间的 <u> 默契 </u> 变得至关重要时，如果 <u> 船上 </u> （球队中）的人才过多，这艘船的航行就会陷入困境。例如，如果一位篮球 <u> 明星 </u> 认为自己在 <u> 赛季 </u> 中 <u> 应该得到 </u> 很高的个人总分，那么在本应传球给队友的情况下，他也可能会选择自己 <u> 投篮 </u> 。学习参与团队运动的小孩子常常被告知：”在团队（TEAM）这个词里没有'我'（I）”。明星球员们 <u> 显然 </u> 没有遵循这一 <u> 体育精神 </u> 的 <u> 基本 </u> 原则。

paragraphs.en: Another possibility is that when there is a lot of talent in {league} matches, some players may make less effort.Just as in a game of tug-of-war ( (拔河比赛) ), whenever a person is added, everyone else pulls the {rope} with less force.They might feel less responsible when wearing their team {uniform} .Since only collective effort is {visible} , the individual contribution of each person becomes less so.
paragraphs.cn: 另一种可能是，当 <u> 联 </u> 赛中人才济济时，一些球员可能会没那么卖力。这就像在拔河比赛中，每增加一个人时，其他人拉 <u> 绳子 </u> 的力度就会变小。当他们穿着队 <u> 服 </u> 的时候，可能会觉得自己的责任没那么强了。因为只有集体的努力是 <u> 显而易见的 </u> ，而每个人的个人贡献则不那么明显。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, the {commercial} aspects of running a team require careful balance.While star players may boost ticket sales by satisfying their {fans} , their costly {contracts} can use up resources needed for other essential areas.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，经营一支球队需要在 <u> 商业 </u> 方面仔细权衡。虽然明星球员可能会通过满足 <u> 球迷 </u> 的需求来增加门票的销量，但他们的 <u> 合约 </u> 昂贵，可能会耗尽其他重要的领域所需的资源。

paragraphs.en: Building up a dream team is {complex} .Simply hiring the best talent may not be the right {recipe} .An {A-team} may require a balance—not just A players, but a few generous B players as well.
paragraphs.cn: 打造一支梦之队是一项 <u> 复杂的 </u> 工作。仅仅聘用最优秀的人才或许未必是正确的 <u> 方法 </u> 。一支 <u> 最佳运动队 </u> 可能需要一种平衡状态——不仅要有A级球员，还要有一些慷慨付出的B级球员。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
